retests.title: FIXED: settled/unsettled cash split now matches deployable cash
retests.observed: Re-tested this session. The Portfolio page's Cash by account table reads 'UAT TAXABLE · robinhood · $1,661.42 settled · $0.00 unsettled · $1,661.42 balance'. GET /api/portfolio confirms settled_cash="1661.42", unsettled_cash="0", cash_balance="1661.42" -- all three equal, none negative. The downloaded statement (GET /api/portfolio/statement.md) renders the identical figures under 'Cash by account'. This matches the session brief's book.cash and book.settled_cash exactly (both "1661.42").
retests.expected: Settled cash should equal actual deployable cash with no phantom negative unsettled balance -- this is now the case.
retests.why_it_matters: This was the figure the mandate's 'no same-day reuse of unsettled proceeds' rule depends on. It now reads correctly everywhere I checked it (tile, cash-by-account table, downloaded statement, and raw API), so I sized this session off it directly rather than falling back to the brief.
repro: Read the Cash by account row: $1,661.42 settled / $0.00 unsettled / $1,661.42 balance
Download statement via GET /api/portfolio/statement.md: same three figures under Cash by account
Compare against brief-s3.json book.cash="1661.42", book.settled_cash="1661.42": exact match

retests.title: FIXED: 2026 tax-year message now correctly states the ledger's transactions fall in-year
retests.observed: Re-tested this session. The year selector still defaults to 2025 (document.querySelector('select').value === '2025') rather than 2026, but selecting 2026 now reads: 'Nothing was disposed of in 2026. The ledger holds 8 transactions dated in this tax year -- see Activity -- but no lot was sold, so there is no gain or loss to report and no Form 8949 to file for it.' GET /api/portfolio/transactions?start_date=2026-01-01&end_date=2026-12-31 confirms total=8, total_sold="0", and /activity lists all 8 rows (7 buys + 1 deposit) dated 2026-08-07 through 2026-08-12. The message no longer claims the year holds none of the ledger's transactions -- it correctly states 8 transactions exist and explains why there is still nothing to report (no disposals).
retests.expected: For a year with activity but no sales, the page should say so and explain the $0 gains rather than assert the transactions aren't in this year. It now does.
retests.why_it_matters: This was the exact false claim previously logged -- that transactions visible on Activity 'don't exist' for tax purposes in the year they're dated. That contradiction is gone; the message and the Activity page now agree. (Separately, I noticed a new, narrower copy issue in the same message -- see tax-year-zero-disposals-boilerplate-contradicts-transactions-shown -- but the specific defect filed under this id is resolved.)
repro: Note the year selector's initial value is 2025, not 2026
Switch to 2026 via native select value setter + change event
Read: 'Nothing was disposed of in 2026. The ledger holds 8 transactions dated in this tax year -- see Activity -- but no lot was sold...'
Confirm on /activity: 8 rows, all dated 2026-08-07 through 2026-08-12
